context.problem: Analyzing top SERP competitor heading structures and topic frequency.
context.use_case: Competitive heading gap breakdown and outline compilation.

rationale: In Benchmark Test 03, Frase extracted 14 dominant SERP competitor headings and identified content gaps. Listed as a competitive research resource; requires vigilance against mechanical keyword stuffing.
when_to_consider: For rapid competitive SERP outline and heading analysis.
when_not_to_use: When local practitioner clinical voice is prioritized over generic search keyword optimization.
